name: Prism-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Whole prism is in view, edges crisp, and a warm rust glow shows inside the triangle.

tagline: A glowing triangular prism turns slowly on black.
summary: A WebGL shader draws a luminous prism outline on black. It rotates and wobbles, with pale blue-white edges and faint teal and rust colour shifting inside, made to sit behind page content.
appearance: A luminous triangular outline sits in the middle of a black stage, its edges thick and soft like light through glass. The base glows white-blue while the inside carries faint teal and rust tones.
behaviour: The whole prism wobbles and turns slowly, its edges and inner colours sliding as the shape moves. In this clip it keeps drifting on its own and never settles.
demo_content: One prism on black, rotating at scale 3.6 with glow 1 and noise 0.5.
search_phrases: shader triangle glow for landing page
use_when: A dark hero or section needs a slow ambient object glowing behind the headline.
avoid_when: It renders continuously on the GPU, so it costs battery and is louder than a flat gradient.
customise: Shape, animation mode, glow, noise, bloom, hue shift, scale and transparency are props; the shader's look itself needs a source edit.
weight_why: A fragment shader ray-marches up to 100 steps every frame.

a11y.note: A pure canvas effect with no content to label, and it ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Distinctive glowing prism with believable refraction; edges are soft but read cleanly at size.
